margot_leah.style_usage: Stardew Valley portrait style and FRAMING exactly like this portrait: large head filling most of the frame, shoulders cut off at the bottom; saturated hue-shifted cel shading, dark coloured (not black) outlines, about 30 colours
margot_leah.description: Stardew Valley portrait of Margot Pell, a museum painting conservator in her early thirties: small woman, warm light skin with freckles across the nose and cheeks, warm brown eyes, dark auburn hair pinned up untidily in a loose bun with a pencil stuck through it and loose strands at the sides, a small brass jeweller's loupe pushed up on her forehead, cream blouse with sleeves rolled up, a sage green work apron over it, a bright curious friendly half-smile. Close bust portrait, head large in frame, three-quarter view

margot_elliott.style_usage: Stardew Valley portrait style and FRAMING exactly like this portrait: large head filling most of the frame, shoulders cut off at the bottom; saturated hue-shifted cel shading, dark coloured (not black) outlines, about 30 colours
margot_elliott.description: Stardew Valley portrait of Margot Pell, a museum painting conservator in her early thirties: warm light skin with freckles, warm brown eyes, dark auburn red-brown hair pinned up messily on top of her head with a yellow pencil through the bun, a brass jeweller's loupe on a band pushed up on her forehead, cream collared blouse, sage green apron straps over the shoulders, an eager talkative smile. Close bust portrait, head large in frame, three-quarter view

margot_portraits.style_usage: Stardew Valley character portraits: exact pixel density at 64x64, bust framing (head and shoulders), large expressive eyes, cel shading in 3-4 tone hue-shifted ramps, dark coloured (not black) outlines, about 30 colours, flat transparent background
margot_portraits.description: Stardew Valley style character portrait of a warm, quick, slightly messy art restorer woman in her early thirties: freckled light skin, brown eyes, dark auburn hair in an untidy pinned-up bun with a pencil through it, a brass magnifying loupe pushed up on her forehead, cream blouse, sage green work apron. Friendly open expression, mid-sentence enthusiasm

margot_leah_b.description: Stardew Valley portrait of Margot Pell, a city museum conservator, early thirties: round friendly face, freckles, warm brown eyes, dark auburn hair twisted up and pinned with a pencil, a few loose strands framing her face, small brass loupe resting on her forehead, cream blouse with a soft collar under a sage green canvas apron, a warm attentive smile as if she just noticed something interesting. Close bust portrait, head large in frame, three-quarter view facing left
